title: DrawTogether
description: You can draw in minecraft now! In multiplayer mode, different players draw the same painting
body:
#### You can draw in minecraft now! In multiplayer mode, different players draw the same painting

### How to use
You can press the B key to start drawing. You can also use the drawing board added in this mod to draw, and in survival mode, combine the paintings from two vanilla versions

### About
- In multiplayer games, the drawing data comes from the creator, and exiting or re entering by the joiner does not affect the drawing canvas. Only when the creator exits Minecraft will the drawing data be lost
- If you need to save the drawing canvas, you can press the K key in the drawing screen, and the drawing data will be saved in the form of an item
- In addition, the mod has added some shortcut keys that can be used during the drawing, as well as some related commands. Detailed information can be viewed in the upper left corner of the drawing screen
